cohort: 130 patients at high risk of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) undergoing Cesarean section
finding: ICS is an effective and safe intervention for patients at high risk of PPH during Cesarean section, effectively increasing hemoglobin, RBC, and hematocrit levels while maintaining coagulation function and clearing tissue factors and alpha-fetoprotein.
mod_finding: This study focused on the use of intraoperative cell salvage during Cesarean sections for patients at high risk of postpartum hemorrhage.
